description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle Software Engineer - Backend (Platform) based in United States. 

 We are looking for a skilled Backend Software Engineer to help build and scale a high-performance payment platform designed for online businesses. In this role, you will contribute to the development of distributed backend services, robust APIs, and reliable integrations. You will work with modern technologies and collaborate with experienced engineers in a product-driven environment. The position offers the opportunity to take ownership of technical solutions, influence architectural decisions, and contribute to a growing product. You will also integrate AI-assisted development tools into your workflow while maintaining high engineering standards. From implementation and testing to deployment and production monitoring, your work will have a direct impact on platform reliability and performance.



Accountabilities:
 
 As part of the backend engineering team, you will develop and maintain scalable services while contributing to technical design, deployment practices, and operational excellence. You will collaborate across teams, take ownership of assigned changes, and help ensure that services remain reliable, maintainable, and compatible as the platform evolves.


 
 Implement backend services within high-performance, distributed systems, working with senior engineers on complex technical decisions.



 
 Contribute to service architecture and API development for internal teams and external integrations, ensuring appropriate communication guarantees, idempotency, and backward compatibility.



 
 Apply modern engineering practices, including test-driven and behavior-driven development where appropriate.



 
 Write clean, maintainable code supported by meaningful unit and integration tests.



 
 Integrate AI tools into the development workflow, critically reviewing and validating generated output.



 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a product-oriented environment.



 
 Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and incorporate suggestions from colleagues.



 
 Document service behavior, design decisions, and operational considerations.



 
 Own assigned changes throughout implementation, testing, deployment, and production verification, including canary releases.



 
 Build observability into services and contribute to diagnosing and resolving production incidents.




 Requirements :

 You bring a solid foundation in backend engineering and practical experience developing reliable services with Java and distributed systems. You are comfortable working with databases, messaging technologies, deployment pipelines, and testing practices, and you can balance independent problem-solving with effective collaboration.


 
 Proficiency in Java and a good understanding of backend architecture, API design, and scalability fundamentals.



 
 Familiarity with distributed systems, including concurrency, error handling, and retry mechanisms.



 
 Practical knowledge of PostgreSQL, including query optimization, indexing, and data modeling.



 
 Understanding of microservice architecture and synchronous and asynchronous service communication, particularly with Apache Kafka.



 
 Knowledge of message publishing, delivery guarantees, durability, and idempotency.



 
 Working knowledge of CI/CD workflows and experience using existing pipelines to deploy changes.



 
 Basic hands-on experience with canary deployments and an understanding of their operational constraints, including backward-compatible changes when multiple service versions coexist.



 
 Experience diagnosing and resolving production incidents, with an understanding of alerts, metrics, logs, and observability.



 
 Ability to instrument application code and understand how telemetry is collected, delivered, and aggregated across different sources.



 
 Practical experience writing unit and integration tests, with sound judgment about what to test and at which level.



 
 Regular experience using AI-assisted development tools, including the ability to select appropriate tasks for AI and validate its output.



 
 Interest in the payments industry, particularly payment routing, retries, and subscriptions, is an advantage.




 Technology Stack:


 
 Java 21+



 
 Docker



 
 Apache Kafka



 
 Spring Framework 6.x



 
 Spring Boot 3.x



 
 PostgreSQL



 
 ClickHouse



 
 Gradle



 
 GitLab




 Benefits :


 
 Flexible work arrangements: Work remotely from a location of your choice, with access to office and coworking spaces where available.



 
 Flexible working hours: Organize your schedule with a start time between 8:00 and 11:00 and a finish time between 17:00 and 20:00, while respecting team collaboration hours.



 
 Professional development: Access courses, conferences, an internal learning library, and English lessons.



 
 Healthcare and wellbeing: Medical insurance, a mental health program, and compensation for sessions with a psychologist.



 
 Paid time off: 28 paid days off annually, sick leave, and fully covered public holidays.



 
 Technical ownership: Contribute to an early-stage payment product, influence architectural decisions, and enjoy meaningful technical autonomy.



 
 Direct impact: Work in an environment where ideas can quickly become product improvements and process changes.



 
 Corporate events: Take part in quarterly team-building activities, workshops, and company-wide events.



 
 Special occasion gifts: Receive gifts to celebrate important personal and professional milestones.



 
 Social impact: Opportunities to participate in charitable initiatives and programs supporting Ukraine.
